gold.taskDescription: Set up and run a community-based system where neighbors can borrow and return tools.

questions.title: Where will the tools be stored and accessed?
questions.description: Identify the physical location for housing and distributing the tools (e.g., your garage, a neighbor's shed, a community center).

questions.title: How many households are you expecting to serve?
questions.description: Estimate the size of the community or neighborhood this library will cover.

questions.title: Who is supplying the tools to start with?
questions.description: Clarify whether tools will come from your own collection, donations from neighbors, purchased stock, or a combination.

questions.title: What types of tools should the library focus on?
questions.description: Determine the category of tools to prioritize, such as gardening, power tools, home repair, or general household items.

questions.title: How will borrowing and returns be tracked?
questions.description: Decide on the tracking method, such as a sign-up sheet, a spreadsheet, a dedicated app, or an honor system.

questions.title: Will there be any rules around borrowing duration or deposits?
questions.description: Establish whether loan periods, late return policies, or damage deposits will be part of the system.

questions.title: How will you recruit and inform participating neighbors?
questions.description: Identify the outreach method to get neighbors on board, such as flyers, a neighborhood app, social media, or word of mouth.
